note: Gain-of-function YWHAZ variants like S230W enhance Raf/Erk signaling and have been linked to cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome presentations featuring cardiac defects.

evidence.text: The S230W variant of YWHAZ enhances Raf-stimulated Erk phosphorylation and acts as a gain-of-function mutation in the RAS-ERK pathway associated with a cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome phenotype.

source.title: A YWHAZ Variant Associated With Cardiofaciocutaneous ...
source.quote: Our data provide strong support to the hypothesis that the S230W variant of YWHAZ is a gain-of-function mutation in the RAS-ERK pathway and may underlie a CFC phenotype.

evidence.text: Cardiac malformations and skin involvement were not observed across four other evaluated Popov-Chang syndrome patients.

source.title: Popov-Chang Syndrome
source.quote: None of the other 4 patients had cardiac malformations or skin involvement.
